execution: Both campaigns ran sequentially with no overlapping build, test, profiling, or separate archival/audit work by this agent. The runner performs its own serialization and checking between timed processes.
policy: Same production binary, explicit requested cap 1 versus 0; implicit threshold-selected passes retained.
latency_quantiles: Pooled timed arrivals within each variant/campaign; P95/P99 use nearest rank ceil(p*N); these are observations, not paired confidence estimates.
